title: dB Conversion
text: Convert magnitude data to decibels (dB or dBm), 1 input, 1 output, no direct feedthrough, {Load resistance (ohms)} sets Scale factor; {Convert to} sets the signal to convert, {Input signal} sets the type of signal and {Add eps to input to protect against "log(0) = -inf"}. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Load resistance (ohms)
params.values: Scale factor 1 (default) | positive scalar | positive integer

params.name: Add eps to input to protect against "log(0) = -inf"
